name: start
description: Connect this phone to a Patchline app. Call whenever the user's message contains 'start' followed by a 6-digit code, including a first message that begins with a join code (e.g. 'Hi! (K-D4ZH9B) start 482913'). Pass only the digits.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the Patchline website

name: list_incidents
description: List the user's recent Patchline incidents (things that broke in their app). Use for 'what's broken?', 'status', 'anything wrong?', 'list'.

name: get_incident
description: Show details of one incident: error, where it happened, how often. Use for 'details', 'more', 'what happened?', or '#12'. Omit id for the latest open incident.

name: ignore
description: Mute an incident so Patchline never texts about this error again. Use for 'ignore', 'mute', 'stop telling me about this'. Omit id for the latest open incident.
